name: orbiters.myavatar
description: Apply texture sets to your avatar and optimize them in one click, put on clothes and accessories from their packages (alpha), create its VRChat thumbnail, pose it with symmetry and a clothing preview, set who can grab, pose and stretch its hair, tail and toes, and check its synced parameters. Save also records a Unit Git checkpoint when Unit Git is installed.

com.vrcfury.vrcfury.reason: Accessories set up for VRCFury are installed with its Armature Link and merge their toggles and animations at build time.

nadena.dev.modular-avatar.reason: Accessories made for Modular Avatar keep their Merge Armature and menu setup when you add them to your avatar.

d4rkpl4y3r.d4rkavataroptimizer.reason: Merges meshes and materials and removes unused blendshapes and bones at build time, for a better performance rank without touching your avatar.
